correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 36,068-face independent-set enumeration; all 18,023 pairs and 218,008 directed incidences checked for an acyclic discrete-Morse matching; critical cells 1 in degree zero, 9 in degree three, 12 in degree four. Signed integer gradient-path matrix has six unit Smith pivots with no remainder; full independent mod-two simplicial reductions give \(b_3=3\) and \(b_4=6\). The 2-connected three-skeleton and integral attaching degree matrix classify the cofiber as a wedge of 3 three-spheres and 6 four-spheres. Fully finite, source code checked from the embedded package.
